mechanism: Engineered endothelial-cell monolayer on catheter surface, continuously secretes nitric oxide (NO), creating bacteriostatic microenvironment.

frozen_criterion.pass_condition: NO secretion >= 1.0 pmol/cm²/s sustained for >= 30 days in CSF-like conditions

comparator: Standard silicone catheter (no NO secretion, infection rate 8-12%)
reference: Published NO secretion rates from endothelial cells: 0.5-5 pmol/cm²/s (Vallance et al., 1989; Malinski et al., 1993)
